Physical devices, Safari/Firefox/Edge, screen reader and other assistive technology were not used.
Whole-logo favicon remains tiny-scale limited; new compact variant is not approved.
Final user review of palette/dark adaptation and public launch remain separate. No merge, public deployment, database, production intake or outbound notifications.
